provenance.citation: Lee S-H, Erber WN, Porwit A, Tomonaga M, Peterson LC, for the ICSH. ICSH guidelines for the standardization of bone marrow specimens and reports. Int J Lab Hematol 2008;30(5):349-364.
provenance.notes: Bone marrow categories and M:E ratio follow ICSH 2008 §2.6.

description: Differential for body fluid specimens (CSF, pleural, peritoneal, synovial). Includes lymphocytes, monocytes/macrophages, mesothelial cells, neutrophils, eosinophils, malignant cells, and other. Left-hand ergonomic key layout.

templates.outSentence: A {{total}}-cell body fluid differential reveals: {{lymph}}% lymphocytes, {{mono_macro}}% monocytes/macrophages, {{mesothelial}}% mesothelial cells, {{neutrophils}}% neutrophils, {{eos}}% eosinophils, {{malignant}}% malignant cells, and {{other}}% other cells.

specimenTypes.targetCountBasis: CLSI H20-A2 defines the reference method as two reviewers counting 200 cells each. 200 is one observer's share of it, which is what routine single-observer practice does — a documented default, not a claim to perform the reference method.

categoryNotes.other: Unclassifiable haemopoietic cells only. Do NOT count into this category: megakaryocytes, macrophages, osteoblasts, osteoclasts, stromal cells, smudged cells, or non-haemopoietic cells such as metastatic tumour cells — ICSH 2008 §2.6 excludes these from the nucleated differential count. Record such findings in the morphology comment instead.
